svg.title: ACMF: confidence-guided multi-scale fusion
svg.desc: Two micrographs, an H5 and an H3, pass through ViT-B/16 models at 224 and 384 pixels. Inverse-entropy weights favour the 224 model on the H5 image and the 384 model on the H3 image, the fused prediction is shown, and an attention rollout overlay highlights the hyphae. Below, macro F1 on the DeFungi test set: ViT-224 88.47, ViT-384 91.88, S1 91.59, S2 91.63, S3 91.35, S4 88.59.
svg.text: Two ViT-B/16 models read each micrograph at 224 px and 384 px; per image, the more confident one gets more weight.
mechanism illustrative · results from the paper
macro F1 (%) · DeFungi test set, 902 images · axis starts at 80

g.text: S1 to S3 land within 0.28 F1 points of each other.
ViT-224 gets more weight on H5 and H6; ViT-384 on
H2 and H3, where hyphal walls and septa need detail.
ViT-384 takes 101.5 ms per image, ViT-224 8.5 ms.
